stories.title: Define Mongo Query Size Estimation Contract
stories.description: Define a standard schema and contract for estimating Mongo query size including document count, projected payload size in bytes, and enforcement thresholds aligned with GPTReader limits.

stories.title: Implement Query Size Estimation Logic
stories.description: Build core logic to estimate Mongo query response size prior to execution using document sampling or metadata (e.g., avg doc size * limit) and enforce caps such as 500KB and 100-document limits.

stories.title: Integrate Size Guard into GPTReader Query Pipeline
stories.description: Integrate the size estimation and guard logic into GPTReader so that oversized queries are rejected or truncated before execution, with clear error handling and audit logging.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Query Size Enforcement
stories.description: Create tests validating estimation accuracy, enforcement of size limits, rejection of oversized queries, and safe handling of edge cases such as large documents or unbounded queries.

stories.title: Expose Query Size Estimation and Guard Status via Internal API
stories.description: Expose internal API or structured response fields in GPTReader to return estimated size, applied limits, and guard actions (truncate/reject) for debugging, audit logging, and downstream system visibility.
